method: Whole pathtricia implementation/header read; Git blob verification. Static analysis only.
findings: Iterator strips one leading slash and splits literal slash-separated components. It does not normalize dot/dotdot, repeated slash or relative inputs; absolute canonical-path precondition relies on callers.
Insertion detects copied input length at PATH_MAX and calls fatal g_error rather than returning per-file incomplete/error. Thus prior concern is not silent input truncation in this entry point.

Path reconstruction checks remaining space only before copying a whole component with g_stpcpy. It does not bound individual component copy by remaining buf_len; smaller caller buffers require separate review. Root/no-basename returns NULL without initializing destination.
Node constructor accepts guint8 depth while stored field is guint16; parent depth+1 therefore narrows at256. Which consumers rely on depth still needs checking.
Duplicate insertion increments trie size each time even when node already exists; size is insertion count rather than unique-leaf count.
Recursive iterator holds trie lock through callbacks; nonzero callback return stops only current recursive invocation and does not propagate globally.
Node dev/inode lazy lookup uses path stat and caches identity without explicit invalidation or local mutex. This is not fresh file identity validation.
Optional embedded demonstration main calls insert with incompatible argument list relative to current signature; optional build not executed.
limits: No original runtime tests or production changes.
Caller canonicalization, root reconstruction and small-buffer reachability remain to inspect. Native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
